parts.how: Mesh/knit upper with fixed eyestay and tongue geometry as in refs.
Traditional lace-up through visible eyelets; no BOA dial, no velcro strap.
Rounded toe box with the same overlay/panel seams as refs; do not reshape to pointed or square.
Rubber outsole with the reference tread/lug pattern and midsole height; lateral and medial profiles match refs.

forbid: do not invent a different outsole tread or lug pattern
do not turn lace-up into slip-on, BOA, or strap closure
do not change toe-box shape or add unlisted overlays
do not redesign midsole stack height or rocker profile

no third-party logos, wordmarks, or brand-identifiable devices (MacBook, iPhone, Apple logo, Nike swoosh, Starbucks cup mark, Amazon smile, Google/Microsoft hardware logos) unless the advertised SKU is that brand or the user explicitly approved it
immutable.colors: Upper and sole colors as in refs; no unlisted accent swaps.
immutable.logos: heel/side mark as in refs only — do not invent wordmarks
immutable.proportions: Keep last silhouette, collar height, and sole thickness matching refs.

notes: Action shots may untie laces (states) but must keep the same outsole pattern and upper panel layout.
